name: Christina Aimi Ravenscroft
original_name: クリスティーナ・愛美・レイヴンズクロフト
source: A half-Japanese ojousama who came to Japan with her parents. Nicknamed "Chris", she immediately gained popularity within the male students after her transfer. Christina is a girl with a kind and relaxed personality, and does have a stubborn and serious side as well, but it is often overshadowed by her airheaded attitude. She is also at times naive (due to her background) and maybe a little too honest.
